# Starling-LM 7B beta

Nexusflow · released 2024-03 · 7.24B params · apache-2.0

**score 39.7** ±1.2 · #707 of 935 · from 7 benchmark results across 7 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/Nexusflow/Starling-LM-7B-beta/blob/39a4d501472dfede947ca5f4c5af0c1896d0361b/config.json): Nexusflow official configuration for Starling-LM-7B-beta (pinned commit): max\_position\_embeddings 8192. Configured maximum, not a benchmarked long-context claim: the official card states no context length. Observed 2026-10-07.</sub>

<pre>
download         size  score
4-bit q4_k_m  ~4.84GB   39.7
8-bit q8_0    ~9.19GB   39.7
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run starling-lm:7b-beta-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run starling-lm:7b-beta-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
